description: Erection of a single storey rear extension with roof lantern to the house and erection of a single storey outbuilding to be used as a office
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( PG-R00-PR-103, PG-R00-PR-104, PG-R00-PR-107, PG-R00-PR-108, PG-R00-PR-105,  PG-R00-PR-106, PG-R00-PR-102, PG-R00-PR-101 received 22 March 2022 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used solely for the purpose of a home office for use by the occupier of the house or for any other purpose incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 18 Palladian Gardens and not as a self-contained dwelling and not for primary residential accommodation.  Nor shall any kitchen, bathroom, toilet or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
